---
name: pnpm audit overrides
description: Non-obvious pnpm workspace behavior when applying automated security fixes.
---

In this workspace, running `pnpm audit --fix` from a package directory can rewrite the root workspace configuration and add overrides there rather than changing that package manifest.

**Why:** A broad package-version override generated by the audit fix did not replace one vulnerable dependency edge, while other generated lower-bound overrides floated dependencies across major versions and broke code generation. The audit stayed nonzero until the missed parent-child edge received a parent-scoped override.

**How to apply:** Replace generated lower-bound targets with exact, API-compatible patched versions. Scan for every forbidden exact version, trace survivors with `pnpm why`, use a parent-scoped override when needed, and validate audits, frozen install, codegen, typecheck, and builds.
